row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (priced per user per year)
row.evidence: Nightfall's help centre says 'To add new users to Nightfall, you must invite them' and SAML SSO is enabled through a Customer Success Manager; no SCIM endpoint is documented in the help centre or developer API docs.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only pricing: Foundation Edition and Premier Edition are 'priced per user, per year' with no published numbers (Contact Sales / 7-day proof of value), so per-user fields are null. Console users are invited manually and given a role; SAML SSO (Okta, Azure and others) is set up by the Customer Success Manager from a supplied user list, plan not stated. No SCIM. Directory Sync (Okta API service integration, Entra ID, Google Workspace) pulls users and groups so DLP policies can include or exclude them; it does not appear to create Nightfall console accounts, so it is recorded as directory_sync in idp, not as provisioning. Developer APIs cover scanning and workflow (violations, findings), not user management.

limitations.text: No SCIM endpoint in the help centre index or developer API docs; console users are invited manually, and SAML SSO setup requires the customer to send Nightfall a user list.
The developer APIs are Scan and Workflow APIs (detection, violations, findings); no user-management endpoints were found.

okta.notes: Okta API Service Integration that lets Nightfall read users and groups for DLP policy scoping; SAML SSO is a separate custom setup.

entra.notes: Directory Sync reads Entra ID users and groups; no gallery tutorial found.

fallbacks.other_sync: Directory Sync from Okta, Microsoft Entra ID and Google Workspace (users and groups for DLP policy scoping, not console accounts)
